topic: Someone finds out they have a half-sibling they never knew about

text: I called the records office. Three transfers. Each transfer played the same hold music. Each agent asked for my chart number. Each agent could not find me. topic: Someone discovers their medical records were mixed up with another patient's
text: The patient portal said I had a positive test result. A positive result. For something I had not been tested for. I called the office. The receptionist put me on hold. I waited. I called again.
